# AccessKit Windows adapter

This is the Windows adapter for [AccessKit](https://accesskit.dev/). It exposes an AccessKit accessibility tree through the UI Automation API.

QuotaBar vendors version 0.29.2 from upstream commit `5801c4a49ff9b2c9ec3f77b3c31272d0da4c5cd3`. Its Windows UI Automation provider exposes the ExpandCollapse pattern for nodes that report an expanded state.
